blocks.orig: Chole Island is a small island just across a small channel from Mafia Island. It belongs to the Mafia Archipelago and makes for a nice visit because of its history, its ruins and the lush vegetation covering the island. After a short boat ride you land on Chole’s beach, after which you walk along the ruins to a fruit bat sanctuary with Comoro flying foxes hanging in the trees. You also visit a traditional boatyard and end the tour with a sundowner in Chole’s ocean-view bar.
blocks.html: Just over a narrow channel from Mafia Island lies Chole Island, a small island. Part of the Mafia Archipelago, it is worth a visit for its history, its ruins and the green vegetation that covers it. A short boat trip brings you to the beach of Chole, and from there you walk past the ruins to a fruit bat sanctuary where Comoro flying foxes hang in the trees. You also see a traditional boatyard, and the tour ends with a sundowner in the ocean-view bar on Chole.
